# Shernan Javier

> Shernan Javier is a software engineer in Toronto, Canada who builds full-stack software, AI products, browser extensions, developer tools, data pipelines, and early-stage startup products.

Shernan Javier is a product-oriented software engineer with experience across startups, fintech, developer tooling, experimentation platforms, browser automation, AI workflows, and consumer products.

He has worked as a founding engineer, software engineer, co-founder, and software engineering intern across early-stage startups and larger technology organizations.

His work emphasizes shipping complete products, rapid prototyping, AI-assisted workflows, browser automation, distributed systems, product engineering, and turning ambiguous ideas into usable software.

## Selected Work

- [MerchMe](https://www.shernanjavier.com/work/merchme): UGC marketplace connecting brands with creators. Co-founded and built the marketplace using Next.js, NestJS, Supabase, Stripe, Redis, and related infrastructure.
- [CreatorGraph](https://www.shernanjavier.com/work/creatorgraph): AI-assisted creator discovery and brand-fit engine using web crawling, Playwright, structured extraction, niche analysis, and compatibility ranking.
- [Xpo](https://www.shernanjavier.com/work/xpo): AI growth tool for X consisting of a web application and browser extension for account analysis, voice-aware drafting, reply discovery, and contextual generation.
- [Behavioural Intelligence](https://www.shernanjavier.com/work/behavioural-intelligence): Browser SDK and event-processing system for converting real-time website behaviour into structured marketing and customer-intent signals.
- [ENSight](https://www.shernanjavier.com/work/ensight): Browser extension for Ethereum wallet safety that observes wallet requests, structures transaction intent, and provides contextual risk information.
- [WYA](https://www.shernanjavier.com/work/wya): Mobile product concept using Bluetooth proximity to help groups reconnect in concerts, festivals, and environments with unreliable cellular connectivity.

## Professional Experience

Shernan's experience includes:

- Software engineering work on behavioural intelligence and real-time browser signal systems.
- Co-founding and engineering MerchMe, a two-sided UGC creator marketplace.
- Founding engineering work at Clover Labs involving browser automation, scraping, growth systems, and consumer product experiments.
- Multiple software engineering internships at TD Bank.
- Software engineering at Thales Digital Identity & Security.
- Web development and experimentation-platform work at Taplytics.

For the most current and authoritative professional history, refer to the resume and individual portfolio case studies.
